vv67:1.1: idaṃ maṇithūṇaṃ vimānaṃ samantato soḷasa yojanāni kūṭāgārā sattasatā uḷārā veḷuriyatthambhā rucakatthatā subhā. || ||
vv67:2.1: Tatth' acchasi pivasi khādasī ca dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vaggū aṭṭhaṭṭhakā sikkhitā sādhurūpā dibbā ca kaññā Tidasacarā uḷārā naccanti gāyanti pamodayanti. || ||
vv67:3.1: Deviddhipatto 'si mahānubhāvo manussabhūto kim akāsi puññaṃ kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. || ||
vv67:4.1: So devaputto attamano Moggallānena pucchito pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
vv67:5.1: Phaladāyī phalaṃ vipulaṃ labhati dadam ujjugatesu pasannamānaso so hi modati saggagato Tidive anubhoti ca puññaphalaṃ vipulaṃ,
vv67:6.1: tath' evāham mahāmuni adāsiṃ caturo phale. || ||
vv67:7.1: Tasmā hi phalaṃ alam eva dātuṃ niccaṃ manussena sukhatthikena dibbāni vā patthayatā sukhāni manussasobhaggatam icchatā vā.
